newsitem.title: ROMANIA: WINTER ENERGY RESOURCES ON ROMANIAN CABINET AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: WINTER ENERGY RESOURCES ON ROMANIAN CABINET AGENDA.

text.p: Romania's outgoing government said on Friday it had stored energy reserves to cover Romania's increased consumption during a harsh 1996/97 winter.
"We have ensured energy reserves for cases when temperatures fall below winter average," Industry Minister Alexandru Stanescu told a news conference.
He said Romania had 8.1 million tonnes of coal, 674,000 tonnes of fuel oil and 1.0 billion cubic metres of natural gas in stock for winter.
Stanescu said the reserves exceeded levels in previous years, with forecasts showing Romania would face a mild winter.
A shortage of fuel and energy reserves in February blocked the country's heavy industry and drew thousands in the streets to protest energy cuts which caused massive layoffs.
Other items on the cabinet agenda on Friday included:
* decision to suplement the budget for parliament and preseidential elections with four billion lei added to a previous 61 billion
* government accord for a South Korean $30 million telecommunications soft loan.
